summary: Read an ascending list of integers whose length is from 2 to 2000. Each integer is from 1 to 30000, and the list contains 1 plus some primes. Every pair with the left value strictly smaller than the right value forms a fraction. Also read a rank K that is at least 1 and at most the number of pairs. Order the fractions from smaller to larger, find the fraction sitting at rank K, and write its numerator and denominator as two integers.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
